newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Barito soars on takeover talk.
newsitem.headline: Barito soars on takeover talk.

text.p: Shares of Indonesian timber company PT Barito Pacific Timber soared on Friday following market talk of a possible takeover, brokers said.
"I heard an Indonesian timber baron was interested in buying a stake in Barito Pacific," a local broker said.
Another local broker said there was another rumour afloat that a prominent group of businessmen could take over the company.
Barito Pacific spokesman Steve Beck denied the rumours.
"Maybe brokers just realise that Barito Pacific's price is undervalued," he added.
Barito topped the active list with 17.2 million shares changing hands, rising 250 rupiah or 18.52 percent, to 1,600 rupiah in late afternoon trade.
